A declared bridge belongs on its own schedule ('; BRIDGE'), judged by R4e and the send ledger; an undeclared run this long is a floating line.

Its layer 1 is commanded to Z0.100 and LANDS AT 0.250mm — 2.5x the gap it meters for, so it deposits 0.7200mm2/mm as a 2.88mm strand instead of the 7.20mm pressed weld its own metering assumes. Emit SET_GCODE_OFFSET Z=-0.150 (machine.zoff_for).

FAIL  R10 line 22: 18.00mm of filament (43.3 mm3) extruded with the head STANDING STILL at Z0.100, before anything has been pinned to the plate (1 such move(s) in this file). Nothing holds that extrudate, so it coils onto the nozzle and rides into the part -- the artifact Oleg photographed on 2026-08-06. Extrudate must be pinned from the first millimetre it leaves the nozzle: call machine.prime(), which moves from the first millimetre at the part's own first-layer rate. Files generated before 2026-08-06 fail this legitimately -- regenerate them rather than weakening the rule.
